conceptZh: 會是學過、做得到的意思
object: a squad of interlocking building bricks and a lopsided first-try brick pile
morph: the bricks proudly build a silly wrong shape, a lumpy hat, then re-stack it into the roof, stacked windows and base of 會
creativeAngle: 積木小隊先得意地堆出一頂歪歪的帽子，發現不對，聳聳肩一下重排成「會」；先錯再對，詞用「學會」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 會, centered in saturated emerald-green strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the little roof 亼 on top, a row of short horizontal bars in the middle, and the small box 曰 below. Cast: a squad of glossy interlocking bricks with dot eyes and tiny stud hats, led by Moxie, an orange 2x3 brick with a confident grin. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Moxie claps a stubby top and the squad scurries around, snapping into a tall wobbly pile with a pointy blue brick on top and two crooked red bricks stuck out the sides like ears. The first 會 is spoken as Moxie spreads her studs proudly toward her creation. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.4s: the pile sways and Moxie squints at it, tilts her whole body, looks at the empty outline, then back at her pile, and her grin droops into a flat line. She shrugs with her whole top. The second 會 is spoken as she gives one tiny clap. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: in one quick move the pile pops apart and every brick leaps into place like a zipper closing, the pointy blue brick becomes the roof, the bars stack as three tidy horizontal bricks, and the last two drop into the box at the bottom with a satisfying click, forming the glyph. Moxie hops, spins midair, and lands with a flourish. Moment four, 5.0s onward: a few of the leftover bricks try to peek back into the glyph, but Moxie waves them off to the side. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Moxie and two helpers dance a tiny step and stack into a little three-brick tower at the bottom, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「會、會、學會」, slowly with clear tones as ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ. First 會 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 學會 around 5.3s as the bricks stack. Stop after the word. Only soft brick clicks, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 會.
